claim: High-resolution audiovisual virtual reality is available anytime.
originalWording: High-resolution audiovisual virtual reality is available anytime.

sources.title: How My Predictions Are Faring — Ray Kurzweil
sources.locator: The Singularity Is Near predictions for 2010, prediction 6, printed p. 132

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: Consumers can use immersive high-resolution visual-plus-audio VR on demand, without requiring a specialist installation.
reference.rationale: Earlier VR systems existed, but ordinary portable on-demand immersive access was limited in 2010. The standalone Quest shipped in 2019 with tracked immersive visual/audio use. “Immersive” is not silently strengthened to indistinguishable reality or all senses.

strict.criterion: The full experience is delivered through the forecast’s tiny glasses/contact display system at arbitrary times.
strict.rationale: Standalone headsets fulfill the audiovisual experience but not the precise unobtrusive optical package.
